series_end_reason: Amicus was acquired by BioMarin (closed 2026-04-27) and deregistered (Form 15-12G 2026-05-07); the last Amicus report is the FY2025 10-K / Q4 2025 release. BioMarin prints no Galafold row.
search_log: Listed every Amicus filing (all forms) for CIK 0001178879 via data.sec.gov/submissions; earnings 8-Ks by item 2.02; product rows parsed from Exhibit 99.1 tables and from 10-Q/10-K tables (scripts/amicus.py).

2016Q3 is the first quarter with net product sales (2,127 thousand vs nil); the 2016-08-09 release says Galafold was available commercially in Germany as of July 31, 2016. 2016Q2 prints no product sales.

The 2018Q2 and 2018Q3 earnings exhibits print their tables as images (no table rows), so those quarters are cited to the 10-Qs (also the quarter's own document). Q4 2016-2021 are derived as 10-K full year less 10-Q nine months because neither 10-K nor release prints a Q4 figure; Q4 2022 is the 'Net Product Revenues' quarterly row of the release.

From 2023Q3 the release prints a separate 'Galafold' row (Pombiliti + Opfolda split out), used from then on; before that the total net product sales line is used (Galafold plus negligible early-access Pombiliti: 60 thousand in 2022Q3). The 2023Q4 release's Galafold full-year figure 387,777 differs from the sum of the four quarters as cited (388,106) by 329 thousand because Q1-Q2 2023 are on the older total line.

Amicus was acquired by BioMarin (closing 2026-04-27, 8-K accession on EDGAR 2026-04-27; Form 15-12G 2026-05-07); the last Amicus periodic report is the FY2025 10-K filed 2026-02-20, and no Q1 2026 report exists. BioMarin's 2026 releases carry no Galafold revenue row (scanned for 'galafold' in BioMarin releases from 2026-04), and BioMarin's post-closing period would be a partial quarter.
